title: Vibecoding a Traditional Roguelike but in turn based Legends of Grimrock style 3d.
author: Epyx911
selftext:
The monster letters are placeholders. I am working on 3d monsters. The game uses 3d space like Legend of Grimrock but is essentially a 3d grid based version of Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup. So single player and uses my own rules but that is the atmosphere I am going for.  The lighting and auto mapping is implemented as well as the procedural dungeon generation of each level.  The lighting shows better when animated in video so will upload a video when im back on my 3 monitor setup...right now just coding in bed. 

Workflow to date:  Claude Code with Visual Code and Unity. Adobe Photoshop/Midjourney for Textures.  Sprites in ChatGPT/Midjourney and [Meshy.Ai](http://Meshy.Ai) for modelling.
